summary: Awwwards redesign pass E2E test. Backend/SEO quick checks: /api/deck 200, /robots.txt 200 (Cloudflare-managed prepends signals but our 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Sitemap: https://okiinc.global/sitemap.xml' block is preserved at the tail), /sitemap.xml 200 with 6 URLs (/, /markets, /strategy, /about, /insights, /contact). Frontend Playwright suite passed 100%. Home preloader shows on first visit; hero renders OKI INC. headline + hero-hud ('NYSE Closed · BTC $78,928 ▲2.03% · Live Public Feed') + hero-btc-ticker + data-skyline canvas + hero-explore-markets-btn. Desktop nav-btc-ticker visible at 1920px viewport with 'BTC $78,928 ▲2.03%'. Platform section: all 4 platform-row-0..3 present; platform-preview caption updates correctly on hover ('01 — LIVE MARKET BOARD' on row0, '04 — PERSPECTIVES' on row3). FAQ: 5 accordion items present, item 0 aria-expanded=true initially; item-4 opens on click and contains faq-phone-link + faq-email-link with href https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=contact@okiinc.global&su=Inquiry%20for%20OKI%20Inc. Home CTAs work: home-method-strategy-link, home-view-markets-link, home-cta-access-btn, home-download-deck-btn (href → backend /api/deck) all present. Footer new columns/links (footer-plat-board-link, footer-plat-search-link, footer-plat-charts-link, footer-deck-link, footer-insights-link) present and footer disclaimer 'Nothing on this site constitutes investment advice' present. Theme toggle flips document.documentElement.dataset.theme light↔dark. About: about-record-section renders 4 timeline entries (2026 x3 + Ahead), about-phone-link, about-email-link (Gmail compose), about-download-deck-btn present. Strategy: strategy-open-markets-link present. Insights: '05 Published' counter present, essay-toggle-* accordions work. Markets regression: market-ticker, market-board, chip-bitcoin, chip-ethereum, chip-spx all OK. Contact regression: contact-email-link, contact-email-mailto, contact-deck-link all present. Mobile 390px: mobile-nav-phone + mobile-nav-email present in mobile menu, 0px horizontal overflow. SEO head: title='OKI Inc. — Global Market Intelligence' (NOT 'Emergent | Fullstack App'), og:image present, twitter:card=summary_large_image, application/ld+json Corporation schema present. Forbidden-phrase scan clean on all 6 routes (holdings / portfolio / cold storage / custody / assets under management — none found). No app-level console errors captured (only third-party/analytics noise ignored per brief).
critical_code_review_comments: public/robots.txt: Cloudflare's edge injects a large 'managed content' block ahead of the file's own directives. Functionally OK (our '*' Allow/Sitemap block is still at the tail and honored by crawlers), but if strict control is needed, host robots.txt on a path Cloudflare doesn't rewrite or disable the AI-scrapers feature.

DataSkyline.jsx spawns a mousemove listener on window that runs every mouse move without throttling and triggers requestAnimationFrame recomputation — fine on desktop, but consider passive:true and rAF throttle for lower-end devices.

LiveMini.useBtc polls /api/market-prices every 60s per mounted component (nav + hero). Two BtcMini instances = 2x traffic. Consider hoisting the fetch to a shared context/hook so only one interval runs regardless of consumer count.

Home.jsx sessionStorage 'oki-entered' means the preloader is skipped on route return via SPA — good UX; but a full reload on any non-/ page then a nav home will still not show it. That's fine but worth documenting.

sitemap.xml + og:image + ld+json use the production host 'https://okiinc.global' hardcoded. That's correct for SEO but ensure the preview URL isn't accidentally indexed (already ok since preview robots.txt is Cloudflare-managed with GPTBot etc. disallowed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids, flows, forbidden-phrase scan, mobile, SEO head verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preloader shows only on first visit per session (sessionStorage 'oki-entered'). Nav is hidden while scrollY<60 on the home hero — must scroll ~200px before nav-menu-toggle / nav-btc-ticker becomes visible. nav-btc-ticker is intentionally hidden below 1280px (xl breakpoint). Theme lives on document.documentElement.dataset.theme (values 'dark'|'light'). robots.txt has Cloudflare-injected AI-crawler block before the app's own directives — treat the presence of 'Sitemap: https://okiinc.global/sitemap.xml' as the pass signal. Live BTC feed was healthy at test time (~$78,928).
